content: CodeMirror 6 + Korean IME: treating CM6 as a React controlled component (value driven by setState) breaks composition — dispatch during compositionstart/compositionend window corrupts jamo assembly. isUserEvent('input.type.compose') on transactions is unreliable for detecting composition-end. Fix: use CM6 as uncontrolled, sync via EditorView.updateListener only after transaction, never force view.setState from React render.
